items.title: Jeff Bezos says he was ‘heavily involved’ in picking the new James Bond, Robert Pattinson - NBC News
novel_facts: Jeff Bezos personally describing his direct involvement in the casting decision
Details of the screen-test process (five finalists, scenes with full costume/sets)
Bezos's quotes from Semafor event revealing selection process and initial bias against Pattinson's fame
Named other finalists considered: Callum Turner, Josh O'Connor, Jack Lowden, Nicholas Hoult
items.reason: This is the same underlying casting announcement, but the incoming article introduces a distinct, newsworthy angle: Bezos's unusual personal involvement in selecting Bond, revealing insider details about the selection process and his influence as studio owner over a major cultural franchise decision. This raises its own public-interest question about corporate/executive influence on creative decisions, distinct from the original casting news, warranting its own story rather than folding into the original announcement.
